content.title: Remember Those Bullish Bitcoin Calls for 2025? They Didn’t Pan Out.
content.summary: Bernstein, a joint venture between investment firm AllianceBernstein and Société Générale, said in July that bitcoin would reach $200,000 by the end of 2025 or early 2026.  It reiterated its view in June, saying “there is simply too much institutional demand for BTC to keep prices flat for long.”  BlackRock’s Fink said in January that bitcoin could trade as high as $700,000 if every big investor allocated a slice of their portfolio to the digital currency.
